# Borr Drilling Limited – Q3 2026 Presentation


Thu, Nov 19, 2026 14:40 CET[Report this content](https://news.cision.com/_editorial/Contact?url=https%3a%2f%2fnews.cision.com%2fborr-drilling-limited%2fr%2fborr-drilling-limited---q3-2026-presentation%2cc4426954)


**Hamilton, Bermuda, November 19, 2026** – Please find enclosed the presentation of Borr Drilling Limited’s financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 to be held on the webcast/conference call at 09:00 New York time (15:00 CET) on Thursday, November 19, 2026.


In order to listen to the presentation, participants may do one of the following:


**a) Webcast**


To access the webcast, please use the following link:


[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/bhay3mku](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/bhay3mku)


**b) Conference Call**


To register for the conference call, please use the following link:


[https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIa56a022638d84d57ab8380de85903ee0](https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BIa56a022638d84d57ab8380de85903ee0)


Participants will then receive dial-in details on screen and via email and may choose to dial in with their unique pin or select "Call me" and provide telephone details for the system to link them automatically.

**About Borr Drilling Limited**


Borr Drilling Limited is an international drilling contractor incorporated in Bermuda in 2016 and listed on the New York Stock Exchange since July 31, 2019 and on Euronext Oslo Børs since May 21, 2026 under the ticker "BORR." The Company owns and operates jack-up rigs of modern and high specification designs and provides services focused on the shallow-water segment to the offshore oil and gas industry worldwide. Please visit our website at www.borrdrilling.com.
